description: This file defines a React functional component called 'TagsSection' that manages and displays tags within a user interface, including features like migration of nested tags to a new system, interaction with view controllers, and rendering optional favorite tags and tag lists.

classes.name: TagsSection
classes.description: A React FunctionalComponent that displays and manages tags, including migration features, favorites, and listing all tags.

methods.name: checkIfMigrationNeeded
methods.description: Checks whether tags need migration based on the current application state.

methods.name: runMigration
methods.description: Prompts the user for migration confirmation and performs the tags migration if confirmed.
